citations.quote: Present-focused preferences exist if agents are more likely in the present to choose an action that generates immediate experienced utility
Preferences can be dynamically consistent even if choices are dynamically inconsistent.
These models share the property that agents choose more impatiently for the present than when they choose for the future.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Ericson-Laibson's present-focused preferences as a meta-category for intertemporal-choice models, classified along two axes (dynamic consistency, taste for commitment), with present bias as one special case.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Present-Focused Preferences Taxonomy
